newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firmer with gas oil, but premiums eas.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firmer with gas oil, but premiums eas.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was about $4 a tonne stronger on Thursday, tracking half-heartedly behind very strong IPE gas oil futures.
Jet cargoes were pegged around Feb IPE +$26-27, a slip on premiums of $1 or so.

The NWE was slow, but an arbitrage opportunity to the east may be opening up, according to some traders. The high cost of shipping and the difficulty in securing suitable tonnage was limiting trading options.
A 2,000 tonne parcel was sold against Feb IPE gas oil +$28 cif Rotterdam via pipeline and February swaps were pegged at +$33 Feb IPE gas oil, about 50 cents weaker than Wednesday.
